original_value: In this paper, we propose a new hybrid model, multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough set model, by combining a multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft set and multi-granulation rough set. We demonstrate some useful properties of these multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough sets. Furthermore, we define multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft (     M k  Q H F S    ) rough approximation operators in terms of      M k  Q H F S     relations and      M k  Q H F S     multi-granulation rough approximation operators in terms of      M k  Q H F S     relations. We study the main properties of lower and upper      M k  Q H F S     rough approximation operators and lower and upper      M k  Q H F S     multi-granulation rough approximation operators. Moreover, we develop a general framework for dealing with uncertainty in decision-making by using the multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough sets. We analyze the photovoltaic systems fault detection to show the proposed decision methodology.

result.paraphrase: This paper introduces a new hybrid model, the multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough set model, formed by combining a multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft set with a multi-granulation rough set. We show several useful properties of these multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough sets. In addition, we define multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft (Mk QHFS) rough approximation operators based on Mk QHFS relations, as well as Mk QHFS multi-granulation rough approximation operators based on Mk QHFS relations. The main properties of the lower and upper Mk QHFS rough approximation operators and the lower and upper Mk QHFS multi-granulation rough approximation operators are examined. We also develop a general framework for handling uncertainty in decision-making using multi Q-hesitant fuzzy soft multi-granulation rough sets. A photovoltaic systems fault detection case is analyzed to demonstrate the proposed decision-making method.
